sentences.en: A dog is distinct from a cat in physical characteristics.
sentences.zh: 狗在生理特征上与猫明显不同。

sentences.en: Lenses with two distinct optical powers are also called "bifocals".
sentences.zh: 具有两种不同光学功能的眼镜也被称为‘双光镜’。

sentences.en: Algeria's most distinct feature is the vastness of its territory.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚最显著的特点是其辽阔的领土。

senses.zh: 清晰的，明显的；截然不同的，有区别的；不同种类的；确实的，不容忽视的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（分开）+tinct（=stinct刺）→把刺分开后显得清楚的→清楚的，明显的
